buy_title: The exact KitchenAid mixers to order, and the model number to check
buy_total: The buttons are paid links: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Prices in this guide come from Target, Kohl's, Walmart, Best Buy and KitchenAid.com between November 19 and 27, 2026 and move with sales; the buttons show today's price.

cards.name: KitchenAid Classic 4.5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer (K45SS)
cards.badge: Our top pick · America's Test Kitchen's mid-priced winner
cards.chip: 4.5 qt · 275 W · 10 speeds · no bowl handle
cards.price: $279.99 at Target ("reg $399.99") on Nov 27, 2026, the same at Kohl's and KitchenAid.com. Past lows: $199.99 at Lowe's (Dec 26, 2025) and $212 at Target with Circle 15% (Dec 1, 2024).
cards.buy_if: you bake cookies, cakes and the odd loaf: America's Test Kitchen (Oct 1, 2026) found it does nearly everything the Artisan does for about $150 less on list, and Consumer Reports says it performs on par with the other KitchenAids it tested.
cards.skip_if: you want a bowl with a handle and a pouring shield (the Artisan has both), or you knead stiff bread dough every week (the 5.5-quart bowl-lift is $299.99 today).
cards.owners: 4.8 of 5 at Target (13,176 reviews) and Walmart (11,042), seen Nov 27, 2026. Praise: easy, sturdy, good value. Complaints: no bowl handle, the head bounces and the motor runs hot on stiff bread dough, and some Walmart buyers got units that looked used.

buy.pick: Classic Series 4.5-quart tilt-head, model K45SSWH (White). Not the KSM96 or the Deluxe KSM97, which sell at the same $279.99 with a higher "reg" price
buy.check: The model number starts K45SS; 275 W; sold by Amazon.com, KitchenAid or a big-box store; inspect a store-pickup box for signs of a return
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: KitchenAid 5.5-Quart Bowl-Lift Stand Mixer (KSM55)
cards.badge: Best deal today · for bread bakers
cards.price: $299.99 at Target ("reg $499.99"), KitchenAid.com and Best Buy; $299 at Walmart (Nov 22, 2026). Lower prices needed a stack: $254.99 at Target with 15% in cart (Nov 30, 2025).
cards.buy_if: you bake bread or double batches: KitchenAid says to choose a bowl-lift for those, the bowl locks at three points instead of a hinged head, and today it costs $50 less than the Artisan.
cards.skip_if: your cabinets are low (about 16½ inches tall, KitchenAid) or you need to lift it in and out of a cupboard (27.5 lb per Target).
cards.owners: 4.9 of 5 at Best Buy (2,090 reviews, Black Matte) and about 4.4 at Walmart (938), seen Nov 27, 2026. Praise: no flex while kneading, big bowl, quiet. Complaints: too tall for one buyer's cabinets, a paddle coating that flaked, a few loud units exchanged.

buy.pick: 5.5-quart bowl-lift, model KSM55SXXX plus a colour code (Target lists it as KSM55). Not the 6-quart or 7-quart bowl-lift, which are different machines
buy.check: 5.5 qt and 11 speeds in the title; sold by Amazon.com or KitchenAid; measure under your cabinets first
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer (KSM150PS)
cards.badge: The upgrade · bowl handle, pouring shield, 20+ colours

photo.credit: Photo: BenFrantzDale, CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $349.99 at Target ("reg $499.99") on Nov 27, 2026, flat since early November; $349.95 at Walmart (Nov 20). Last year's low: $297.49 at Target with 15% in cart (Nov 30, 2025).
cards.buy_if: you want the bowl handle, the pouring shield and the colour: Food Network (Oct 12, 2026) and CNN Underscored name it best overall. Under $300 is the price to wait for.
cards.skip_if: you want the most mixer for the money today: the Classic is $70 less and the 5.5-quart bowl-lift $50 less.
cards.owners: 4.9 of 5 at Target (25,794 reviews) and 4.8 at Best Buy (3,692, Ice), seen Nov 27, 2026. Praise: lasts for years, attachments, colours. Complaints: heavy to store, the head bounces or unlocks on heavy dough, coated beaters that chip.

buy.pick: Artisan Series 5-quart tilt-head, model KSM150PSER (Empire Red). Not the Artisan Plus (KSM50PKVX), a KSM154 or KSM195 bundle, or the 4.5-quart Classic
buy.check: The model number starts KSM150; 325 W; colours are priced differently, so pick the colour after the price
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: KitchenAid Artisan Mini 3.5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer (KSM3316X)
cards.badge: Small kitchens only · wait for a deeper cut
cards.price: $329.99 at KitchenAid.com ("reg $449.99", Nov 19, 2026), only $20 under the full-size Artisan. Target does not sell it. Past low: $240 at KitchenAid.com (Nov 2023).
cards.buy_if: counter or cabinet space is the problem and you bake small batches: it is about 12.3 inches tall and 16 lb (KitchenAid), and America's Test Kitchen named it the best small mixer.
cards.skip_if: you double recipes or bake bread: ATK measured 1.9 quarts of usable bowl, it cannot take the ice cream bowl, and Fresh Loaf posters found it weak on bread dough.
cards.owners: 4.9 of 5 at Best Buy on 158 reviews (some incentivized) and about 4.7 at Walmart (456), seen Nov 27, 2026. Praise: compact, light, takes the same hub attachments. Complaints: the small bowl, a toy-like feel for some, and strain on bread.

buy.pick: Artisan Mini 3.5-quart tilt-head, model KSM3316XCU (Contour Silver); KSM3311X is the older code of the same mixer
buy.check: 3.5 qt in the title; sold by Amazon.com or KitchenAid, not a marketplace seller; buy at $280 or less
